_comment: DEPTH DIAGNOSTIC. Same cell as data-axis-varying-rule, but dumps decoded
eval samples so a below-chance or otherwise inexplicable number can be
Samples show the demos, the query, the target and what the model emitted, so
'did it use the rule it was shown?' is answerable by reading rather than by
inferring from an aggregate. Recovering each sample's map from its demos and
checking the output against it turned one wrong conclusion into a right one
